benchmark.source:
(in-package :cl-user)
(defclass slot-benchmark () ((s0 :initform 0) (s1 :initform 0) (s2 :initform 0) (s3 :initform 0) (s4 :initform 0) (s5 :initform 0) (s6 :initform 0) (s7 :initform 0) (s8 :initform 0) (s9 :initform 0) (s10 :initform 0) (s11 :initform 0) (s12 :initform 0) (s13 :initform 0) (s14 :initform 0) (s15 :initform 0)))
(let ((object (make-instance 'slot-benchmark)))
 (dotimes (trial 4)
  (let ((start (get-internal-real-time)))
   (dotimes (i 2000) (incf (slot-value object 's15)))
   (assert (= (slot-value object 's15) (* 2000 (1+ trial))))
   (format t "SLOT-BENCH ~D ~D~%" trial (- (get-internal-real-time) start))
   (finish-output))))
